claims: Madagascar is an island nation off East Africa.
Over 90% of Madagascar's wildlife is found nowhere else, including lemurs, chameleons, and baobab trees.
Antananarivo is the capital city of Madagascar.
Madagascar's population is over 30 million.
Madagascar's culture blends Austronesian and Bantu influences.
Antananarivo is often called Tana.
Antananarivo is in the central highlands.
Madagascar's currency is the Malagasy ariary (MGA).
Madagascar is known as the "Great Red Island".
Madagascar has red, iron-rich soil.
Madagascar separated from Africa 180 million years ago.
Madagascar separated from India 90 million years ago.
Madagascar has over 18 ethnic groups.
The Merina of the central highlands are the most numerous ethnic group in Madagascar.
Madagascar's population combines traditions from early Indonesian settlers and later African arrivals.
Madagascar's economy is mostly agricultural.
75% of Madagascar's population lives below the poverty line.
Malagasy and French are the languages of Madagascar.
Christianity is the predominant religion in Madagascar.
Madagascar has a tropical climate.
Madagascar's cyclone season generally runs from November to April.
